# Nodeloop

> Open-source React components (MIT) that show how a good AI agent behaves: streaming, trust, approval, planning, chat and input. Every pattern runs as a live simulation and can be copied into a project. Built with React, Tailwind and shadcn-ready.

Source: https://github.com/Guhan3132/nodeloop

## Patterns

- [Home](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/): full gallery of agent UI patterns
- [Guide: UX patterns for AI agents](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/guides/agent-ui-patterns): how to choose a pattern for each agent job
- [Get started](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/get-started): install and use the components
- [Customising components](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/customize): theming and changes
- [Tokens and theming](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/tokens): design tokens
- [Playground](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/playground): the full agent flow in one place
- [About](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/about): what Nodeloop is

## Component pages

Each page has a live demo, the source code, and usage notes.

- [Full sitemap](https://nodeloop.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
